Nor'easter Storm Threatens East Coast with Wind, Rain, and Flooding

A nor'easter storm is bringing significant wind, rain, and a threat of flooding to the East Coast of the United States. The storm is characterized by huge waves and high tides, which are already causing coastal areas to flood.
